source.llamacpp_comparison: llama.cpp keeps F16 score/probability fragments inside its cooperative-matrix tile; this diagnostic isolates only low-precision score storage while retaining scalar F32 QK and PV.

candidate.description: Keep the complete scalar F32 QK reduction, round each scaled result once into an FP16 LDS score plane, and use the rounded value for producer max and softmax. Retain exp32, ordered denominator, scalar F32 PV, gate, and output stores.

leaf.protocol: nine counterbalanced samples, five warmups, 50 launches per timed burst

decision.result: Reject before trace, resident integration, or recurrent quality testing. Halving score-plane LDS bytes and removing score-scaling replays is performance-flat while already changing gated BF16 output.
decision.next: Score-plane storage is closed as an isolated lever. The missing llama.cpp speed comes from cooperative QK/PV execution, not score storage precision.
